body.name: Directed downward-closed coupled cover
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G,H)\) holds exactly when, for every loopless spanning subgraph \(F\) with \(E(F)\subseteq E(G)\) and every \(C\in\mathcal D_F\), there exist a loopless spanning subgraph \(K\) with \(E(K)\subseteq E(H)\), a matrix \(D\in\mathcal D_K\), a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\), and nonzero scalars \((a_i)_{i\in U_C}\) such that \(C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\) for every \(i\in U_C\) and \(T_S(C)=T_S(D)\) for every \(S\in\mathcal I\).
